units.source_text: 二条院里的人相与议论：“不知从哪里回来？

en.t: The people at the Nijoin residence discussed it among themselves: “I wonder where he has come back from?

units.source_text: 看样子懊恼得很呢。”

en.t: From the look of him, he seems terribly distressed.”

units.source_text: 源氏公子一直走进寝台的帐幕[\[26\]](#part1333.html#m26)里，

en.t: Prince Genji went straight into the curtains around his bed,

units.source_text: 抚胸冥想，

en.t: pressed his hand to his chest, and sank into thought,

units.source_text: 越想越是悲恸。

en.t: and the more he thought, the more grief-stricken he became.

units.source_text: “我为什么不搭上那车子一同前往呢？

en.t: “Why did I not get into that carriage and go with her?

units.source_text: 如果她苏醒过来，

en.t: If she wakes up,

units.source_text: 将作何感想呢？

en.t: what will she think?

units.source_text: 她知道我抛撇了她而去，

en.t: When she learns that I abandoned her and left,

units.source_text: 定将恨我无情吧。”

en.t: she will surely hate me for being heartless.”

units.source_text: 他在心绪缭乱之中，念念不忘此事，

en.t: In the turmoil of his mind, he could not stop thinking of this,

units.source_text: 不觉胸中堵塞，气结难言。

en.t: and before he knew it, his chest felt blocked and his breath caught so that he could hardly speak.

units.source_text: 他觉得心痛，身体发烧，非常痛苦。

en.t: His heart ached, his body burned with fever, and he suffered greatly.

units.source_text: 他想：“如此病弱，不如死了罢休！”

en.t: He thought, “If I am this sick and weak, I would be better off dead!”

units.source_text: 到了日上三竿之时，犹未起身。

en.t: Even when the sun was already high, he still did not rise.

units.source_text: 众侍女都觉得惊讶；

en.t: All the ladies-in-waiting were surprised;

units.source_text: 劝用早膳，亦不举箸，

en.t: when they urged him to take his morning meal, he would not even lift his chopsticks,

units.source_text: 只是唉声叹气，愁眉不展。

en.t: but only sighed and remained sunk in sorrow.

units.source_text: 这时候皇上派使者来了。

en.t: At that moment, a messenger sent by the Emperor arrived.

units.source_text: 原来昨天早就派使者找寻公子行踪，

en.t: It turned out that messengers had already been sent the day before to search for the prince,

units.source_text: 不知下落，皇上心甚挂念。

en.t: but since his whereabouts were unknown, the Emperor had been deeply worried.

units.source_text: 所以今天特派左大臣的公子们前来探视。

en.t: Therefore, today he had specially sent the sons of the Minister of the Left to inquire after him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子吩咐只请头中将一人“来此隔帘立谈”[\[27\]](#part1333.html#m27)。

en.t: Prince Genji ordered that only To no Chujo be invited to “come here and speak while standing beyond the curtain.”

units.source_text: 公子在帘内对他说：“我的乳母于五月间身患重病，削发为尼。

en.t: From behind the curtain, the prince said to him, “In the fifth month, my nurse fell gravely ill and took the tonsure as a nun.

units.source_text: 幸赖佛佑，恢复健康。

en.t: Fortunately, through the Buddha’s blessing, she recovered her health.

units.source_text: 不料最近旧病复发，衰弱特甚，

en.t: Unexpectedly, her old illness recently returned, and she has become especially weak,

units.source_text: 盼望我前去访问，再见一面。

en.t: so she hoped I would visit her and see her once more.

units.source_text: 此乃我幼时亲近之人，今当临终之际，

en.t: She is someone who was close to me in childhood, and now she is near death,

units.source_text: 若不去访，于心不忍，因此前去问病。

en.t: so I could not bear not to visit her, and therefore went to ask after her illness.

units.source_text: 不料她家有一仆役正在患病，

en.t: Unexpectedly, there was a servant in her household who was ill,

units.source_text: 突然病势转重，不及送出，即在她家死去。

en.t: and his condition suddenly worsened; before he could be sent away, he died there in her house.

units.source_text: 家人不敢告我，直到日暮我去之后，才将尸体送出。

en.t: The family did not dare tell me, and only after I left at dusk did they carry out the body.

units.source_text: 过后我得知此事。

en.t: I learned of this only afterward.

units.source_text: 现在将近斋月[\[28\]](#part1333.html#m28)，宫中正在准备佛事。

en.t: Now the abstinence month is approaching, and the palace is preparing Buddhist rites.

units.source_text: 我身不洁，未便造次入宫参见。

en.t: Since I am ritually impure, it would not be proper for me to enter the palace casually and have an audience.

units.source_text: 我今晨又感受风寒，头痛体热，颇觉痛苦。

en.t: This morning I also caught a chill; my head aches, my body is feverish, and I feel rather miserable.

units.source_text: 隔帘致辞，实属无礼。”

en.t: To address you from behind a curtain is truly discourteous.”

units.source_text: 头中将答道：“既然如此，我当将此情由复奏皇上。

en.t: To no Chujo replied, “If that is the case, I shall report these circumstances to the Emperor.

units.source_text: 昨夜有管弦之兴，其时皇上派人四处寻找，

en.t: Last night there was a musical entertainment, and at that time His Majesty sent people to search everywhere,

units.source_text: 未得尊踪，圣心甚是不乐。”

en.t: but they could not find you, and His Majesty was deeply displeased.”

units.source_text: 说罢辞去，既而折回[\[29\]](#part1333.html#m29)，

en.t: After saying this, he took his leave, but soon turned back,

units.source_text: 又问道：“您到底碰到了怎样的死人？

en.t: and asked again, “What sort of dead person did you actually encounter?

units.source_text: 刚才您所说的，怕不是真话吧？”

en.t: What you said just now may not be the truth, may it?”

units.source_text: 源氏公子心中吃惊，勉强答道：“并无何等细情，

en.t: Prince Genji was startled inwardly, but forced himself to answer, “There are no special details,

units.source_text: 但请将偶尔身蒙不洁之情由奏闻可也。

en.t: so please simply report that I happened to become ritually defiled.

units.source_text: 怠慢之罪，实无可逭。”

en.t: As for the fault of neglecting my duties, there is truly no escaping it.”

units.source_text: 他说时装作若无其事，

en.t: As he spoke, he pretended that nothing was the matter,

units.source_text: 然而心中充满着无可奈何的悲哀，情绪异常恶劣，

en.t: yet his heart was filled with helpless sorrow, and his spirits were terribly low,

units.source_text: 因此不欲和别人对面谈心，

en.t: so he had no desire to meet anyone face to face and speak with them,

units.source_text: 只是召唤藏人弁[\[30\]](#part1333.html#m30)入内，

en.t: but merely summoned Kurodo no Ben inside,

units.source_text: 叫他将身蒙不洁之情由如实奏闻。

en.t: and ordered him to report truthfully the circumstances of his ritual defilement.

units.source_text: 另外备一封信送交左大臣邸，

en.t: He also prepared a letter and had it delivered to the residence of the Minister of the Left,

units.source_text: 信中说明因有上述之事，暂时不能参谒。

en.t: explaining in it that, because of the matters described above, he could not pay a visit for the time being.
